text: Data acquisition and handling system (DAHS): calculation of the validated hourly, daily and annual means per the LCP Regulation and the environmental permit with the uncertainty deduction, storage of at least 5 years, reports for the authority, and transmission of the data to the environmental authority by the online link required by the permit; the DAHS is in its own zone (section 13) and signals to the DCS by hardwired 4-20 mA for the operator display and the control of the SCR.
